response.sql: WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0 GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM per_driver) SELECT p.driverId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.mean_wins AS diff FROM per_driver p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_wins - o.mean_wins) IS NULL, diff DESC, p.driverId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The 'higher side' of the 1.0 dividing line means points strictly greater than 1.0; records with exactly 1.0 points fall on the lower side.

The overall mean is the unweighted mean of the per-driver average wins (one value per driver), as the request states. The 'proceed only if the mean exists' condition is implemented by filtering out all rows when the mean is NULL. Ties in the difference are broken by driverId.

alternatives.interpretation: Records with points of at least 1.0 count as the higher side (>= 1.0).
